verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI advertises querying/editing large codebases with a 1M-token context window and one HN user praises it for navigating large codebases 'effortlessly' without needing selective context (gemini-cli-comm-1, gemini-cli-gh-1, gemini-cli-docs-3), but other hands-on reports directly contradict this, saying it is 'so stupid at navigation in the codebase it takes 10x as long to do anything' and that it ignores its own GEMINI.md context files entirely (gemini-cli-comm-13, gemini-cli-comm-14). Missing for 10: consistent independent verification of automatic whole-repo mapping/explanation, resolution of the navigation-quality complaints, and clear proof context files are reliably honored.
